remarks.name: Aaron Levie
remarks.role: ceo box - your business lives in content. unleash it with AI
remarks.text:
This week’s tech earnings calls were a critical reminder of how valuable the relationship is between software and AI.

Software provides the guardrails for how data is managed, how business logic in workflows are maintained, how you manage and govern access to information, how you protect data, and more. You want these systems to work the same way every time, without fail. 

Agents, on the other hand, work inside these systems and with this data to execute on tasks just like people would have. But at a scale far greater than people ever did, which is especially why the deterministic controls matter more than ever.  

And in fact many of the best ways to deploy agents will be directly within the software systems themselves, like from Salesforce, Box, Harvey, ServiceNow, and so on. These platforms can optimize agents for their workflows and domains, with evals and context that are unique to their vertical, as well as connect to other 
 agents headlessly. 

The net result is both software and AI adoption go up, hand in hand. Software and Agents are going to work together, and ultimately grow the size of the IT TAM dramatically as a result over time.
remarks.translation: 本周的科技财报电话会议是一个重要提醒，说明软件与人工智能之间的关系有多么宝贵。软件为数据管理方式、工作流中业务逻辑的维护、信息访问的管理与治理、数据保护等提供了护栏。你希望这些系统每次都以相同方式运行，万无一失。而智能体则在这些系统内部、利用这些数据来执行任务，就像人类原本会做的那样。但其规模远超人类以往所能达到的水平，这正是确定性控制比以往任何时候都更重要的原因。事实上，部署智能体的许多最佳方式将直接嵌入软件系统本身，例如来自Salesforce、Box、Harvey、ServiceNow等平台。这些平台可以针对其工作流和领域优化智能体，利用其垂直领域独有的评估与上下文，并无头连接其他智能体。最终结果是软件和人工智能的采用率携手提升。软件与智能体将协同工作，并随着时间推移大幅扩大IT总可寻址市场的规模。

remarks.name: Madhu Guru
remarks.role: Sr Director, AI at Meta; Prev: Google - Led Gemini, Veo, Nano Banana.
remarks.text:
If you lead AI for an enterprise, the highest leverage thing you can do is to make your AI stack model agnostic. 

There are two things I would invest in.

1/ Today: build an eval suite that fully captures your use cases and business outcomes. Most companies I’ve seen do not do a good job of this.

2/ Within the next year: build the capability to post-train open models. The talent gap here is even more acute, so start planning today.

This gives you the flexibility to switch models, customize them, compare them on your own workloads, and optimize for the best combination of quality, cost and latency.

own the evals, own the models.
remarks.translation: 如果你在企业中负责人工智能，你能做的杠杆效应最大的事情就是让你的AI技术栈做到模型无关。我会投资两件事。1/ 今天：构建一套评估套件，完整覆盖你的使用场景和业务成果。我见过的大多数公司在这方面做得并不好。2/ 未来一年内：构建对开放模型进行后训练的能力。这方面的人才缺口更加严重，所以今天就要开始规划。这会让你拥有切换模型、定制模型、在自己的工作负载上比较模型，并针对质量、成本和延迟的最佳组合进行优化的灵活性。掌握评估，掌握模型。

remarks.name: Peter Yang
remarks.role: Practical AI tutorials and interviews for busy people
remarks.text:
I receive around 3-5 requests to test a new AI product daily. Almost all of them require creating a new account and logging into a separate website or app.

Meanwhile, I basically only use ChatGPT, Grok, etc to do everything on my computer and browser.

These harnesses already have all my context and I don't want to start over from scratch with a new website or tool that only understands a small slice of my data. 

So with a few exceptions, the new products that I'm mostly likely to adopt need to work in today's top AI harnesses.

I realize only a small segment of users behave this way but I bet this segment will expand drastically soon.
remarks.translation: 我每天大约会收到3到5个测试新AI产品的请求。几乎所有这些产品都要求创建新账户，并登录到一个单独的网站或应用。与此同时，我基本上只用ChatGPT、Grok等工具在电脑和浏览器上完成所有事情。这些工作平台已经拥有我的全部上下文，我不想从头开始，去用一个只了解我数据一小部分的新网站或工具。因此，除少数例外，我最可能采用的新产品需要能在当今顶尖的AI工作平台中运行。我意识到只有一小部分用户会这样做，但我敢打赌，这个群体很快就会大幅扩大。

remarks.role: Practical AI tutorials and interviews for busy people
remarks.text:
I've uploaded 160 pages of medical records to AI and it has been incredible. 

Who's on the team for @ChatGPT Health? It needs to be designed not just for the patient but also for the care giver & family. 

Right now it feels like it's a strictly single player experience? I understand medical records are sensitive but close family sharing should be allowed.
remarks.translation: 我已将160页的医疗记录上传至AI，效果令人惊叹。@ChatGPT Health的团队有哪些成员？它的设计不仅要面向患者，还应兼顾照护者和家人。目前感觉这纯粹是单人体验？我理解医疗记录具有敏感性，但应允许近亲共享。

podcasts.originalExcerpt: A few years ago, Caltech Prof. and co-founder of Accelerated Understanding, Anima Anandkumar set out to develop the first open-source weather model with AI. Talking to experts in the field, she was met with skepticism. Weather is chaotic, physics simulations are hard, have been developed for decades, and require supercomputers, the data just isn’t there. Despite reservations, Anima went forth and built. Within a year her team had developed FourCastNet, a predictive model that is competitive with the best physics-based simulations available. Thanks to Anima, and her follow up work, anyone can now predict weather accurately over a short timescale using consumer grade GPUs.
